messages:
maya: heads up — ops seeing a spike in fncall schema rejects for a few dedicated customers in eu-west. fallback route is sending requests to the degen model and a customer just flagged unexpected cost. anyone digging?
ben: link to the query or the alert?
maya: pasted the quick metrics from graphite: `fncall_schema_reject_rate{region=\"eu-west\"}` => 0.87% (2m window), top routes: invoke-v1, tool-invoke. affected accounts: acct-1234, acct-7ff.
monitorbot: Alert: fncall_schema_reject_rate > 0.5% for eu-west (2m).
elena: can we see example payloads? sounds like validation errors rather than model failures.
maya: one sample error from logs: ```validation_error: "expected object, got array" payload: ["...user-provided-array..."] route_id: "invoke-eu"```
anthony: hmm that sounds like an upstream change in caller code sending arrays for tool args. We should classify this as client-side malformed requests and not bill them the same as a successful token generation.
ben: current pipeline attributes cost to the initial request regardless of schema validation outcome. that's why customers see charges even when handler rejects early.
elena: console UX ask — we should surface a separate metric/graph for schema_rejects (count + pct) per route and per account, with drilldown to recent raw payload samples (sanitized). right now it's buried in traces.
maya: customer support ticket id #C-4821; they have 3k reject events and are upset about charges.
anthony: short-term fix: mark validation outcomes with a billing_tag = "validation_reject" and have billing pipeline drop or zero-rate those. Long-term: add soft-validate toggle in rollout so dedicated customers can choose permissive/coercion modes.
bend: typo: @anthony^ ben: agree. telemetry change first — add a tag on the trace: `validation_reason` + `schema_version` so we can filter by validator rules. also sample 1% of payloads to S3 for triage.
elena: I'll open a console PR to add a schema_rejects panel and a per-account breakdown. low-risk UI change.
maya: ops question — if we stop billing those immediately, will quota/usage dashboards break? some billing jobs expect token counts to match api-usage events.
anthony: adapt billing pipeline to ignore events tagged `validation_reject` before roll. quick patch to the gateway should tag them in the event stream. we can backfill adjustments for impacted accounts.
opsbot: deploy-bot: Canary: gateway/0.9.12 -> eng-dedicated in 5m (manual approval required).
ben: i'll add the telemetry tag change (gateway PR). will also add a metric `fncall.validation_reject_total` with labels `route,account,reason`.
elena: tagging ownership: maya -> account outreach + support comms, ben -> telemetry/gateway PR, elena -> console dashboard PR, anthony -> billing pipeline change + gateway billing-tag patch.
maya: thanks. i'll message support template and ping SRE if spike continues (>1% for 10m). :thumbsup:
monitorbot: Note: will escalate to pager if fncall_schema_reject_rate > 1.0% for 10m."
